_doc: Pod kinds registry — the TWO-AXIS model: `kind` is the HANDLING class (extraction, KG admissibility, lifecycle, materializer) and a governed VARIANT TAG is the routing handle consumers filter by (query(kind='intention', tags=['meal'])). Every pod 'kind' minted anywhere has an entry here — PodStore.put refuses NEW pods with unregistered kinds, and when an entry declares `variants`, a new pod must carry EXACTLY ONE of them as a tag (register first, mint second; a governed vocabulary can't fork). `role_tags` are additional documented tags (e.g. run_summary) — additive, not enforced. `kg_admissible` controls whether kg_edge_metadata may reference this pod kind by URI — pod_store remains the sole source of truth for pod content (no kg_node mirror). `retention` drives the nightly pod_retention sweep: {"mode": "keep_forever"} (default when omitted) or {"mode": "keep_days", "days": N, "keep_latest": M} — the newest M survive regardless of age (per VARIANT when the kind declares variants); pods with projection rows (secrets) are never swept. A NEW KIND is justified only when HANDLING differs; a new domain or producer reuses a family kind + a new variant word.
_canonical_example: Append a new entry to 'kinds' as a starting point for a new pod kind. See skills/extending-emi-pod-kinds/SKILL.md for the field reference.

image.description: Image artifact (PNG/JPEG/etc) posted to chat. Stored content-addressed under data/images/<sha>.<ext>. Body is populated by the vision-extraction pass (caption + OCR). Admissible to the KG because user-shared photos are referenced by entities/events (a person depicted_in datapod:image:...).

email.description: Inbound email. one_liner=subject, body=email body verbatim. Source refs back to the event_repository row.
email._doc_excluded_from_kg: Email content is noisy, sensitive, and token-heavy. Not referenced by KG edges.

chat_cluster.description: Resolved chat segment from pod_classifier with entity-anchored sections. Body is the resolved markdown sections.
chat_cluster._doc_excluded_from_kg: Chat clusters are conversation context, not facts. KG ingests facts extracted FROM clusters; clusters themselves are not KG citizens.

note.description: Freeform authored content pod — a user- or agent-curated note, list, or collection (e.g. a contacts/email list). one_liner=title, body=verbatim content. Minted on demand via the mint_pod tool.

file.description: User file ingested from disk (PDF, document, archive, ...) via mint_pod_from_path / file_ingest. Content-addressed copy; metadata.stored_path points at the backing file for attachment.

tool_result.description: Output artifact from a tool run (execute_code sandbox outputs: result files, generated documents, images). one_liner names the file; text content inline in body, binary content at metadata.stored_path. Superseded working artifacts — retention-swept.

service_loop.description: Internal pod_classifier service-loop placeholder. Not user-facing content; emitted to keep the pipeline running when there's nothing to classify.

research_finding.description: One durable research finding minted by the planner's findings_to_pod path (canonical id hash of run+unit). Read back as context by later research and by /subconscious surfaces.

feedback.description: User feedback on a suggestion pod. Variant tag names the channel: #comment (from /subconscious, /meals, chat-judged meal replies) awaiting the feedback_extractor — its 'unprocessed' tag flips to 'processed' after belief extraction; kept as belief-evidence provenance. metadata.target_pod_id points at the pod the feedback is about.

intention.description: One advisory proposal from a subconscious lane — the arbiter decides what reaches the calendar; superseded daily. Variant tag names the domain: #meal (dish/window/date/ingredients), #wellness, #romantic, #shopping (items + suggested date; grocery sync applies on user confirmation). A lane's per-run summary pod carries the domain variant PLUS the #run_summary role tag and references its items via metadata (item consumers key on metadata shape — date/dish — so summaries pass through them inert).

plan.description: A standing plan pod the lanes honor. Variant tag names which: #weekly_meals (the weekly planner's 7-day slot grid + theme; the daily proposer's skeleton, easy-meals served-history source) and #weekly_schedule (the scheduler arbiter's single weekly source of truth; is_anchor items are locked constraints every proposer reads back). keep_latest protects the newest per VARIANT.

delivery.email.description: Audit record of an outbound email send (what was sent, to whom, when) minted by the sending surface.

health.private.description: Sealed response content carrying private health data (http_request/execute_code seal paths). Body readable only above the kind's authority floor; never inlined into LLM context by the sealing tool.

auth.session.description: Sealed web session state minted by http_request (cookies/session tokens by pointer). Handled by courier code paths; not LLM-readable content.

auth.bearer.description: Identity-style secret pod: bearer/API token referenced by env pointer, materialized into authority-banded projections. Minted via put_secret_pod only.

auth.oauth.description: Identity-style secret pod: OAuth credential set (access/refresh token pointers + provider config), materialized into authority-banded projections. Minted via put_secret_pod only.

identity.ssn.description: Identity-style secret pod: SSN referenced by env pointer with banded projections (full=courier-only, last4/redacted/format lower bands). Minted via put_secret_pod only.

_doc_chat_introduced: Pod source_kind values used by upstream code to mark pods that originated from user chat activity (uploads, attachments, manual mints). Kept for upstream codepaths that classify intake source; no longer drives KG admission (the kg_admissible flag on each kind is now the sole gate).
